SELECT DISTINCT cr.room_id, cr.admin_id, cr.title, cr.use_yn, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM chat_room cr WHERE cr.admin_id = #{adminId} AND cr.use_yn = 'Y' AND (
cr.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.room_id = cr.room_id AND cm.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC
